description: National Land Transport Network (current and 2014) is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub and Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group and published by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications and the Arts; Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts (DITRDCSA). Members: National Land Transport Network; National Land Transport Network (NLTN) 2014. Example entry: The National Land Transport Network (the Network) is a network of nationally important road and rail infrastructure links and their intermodal connections. The Network was reviewed and updated on 1 July 2020 under the National Land Transport Network Determination 2020 which originally comes under the National Land Transport Act 2014. Coverage is Australia, 2005 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as infrequent, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-05-13. Files and pages listed: API, HTML (3 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
